calendarNotes: Pomona Unified lists 180 student days and 188 days of service for 2026-2027. The first day of school is August 12, 2026 and is a shortened day for all students. Professional development student-free days are listed August 6, August 7, August 10, September 15, November 2, and January 19. Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Spring Break runs March 29 through April 2, 2027. Elementary school parent conferences run October 15-23, 2026 and March 11-19, 2027. The last day of school is May 28, 2027 and is listed as a shortened day for all students with no late start.

calendarFaqs.q: Are shortened days the same for every Pomona Unified school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The district calendar identifies shortened days for all students, elementary students, and high school students. Families should confirm exact dismissal times with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: How does Pomona Unified label minimum days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar uses the term shortened day rather than one universal minimum-day label. Check whether a date applies to all students, elementary students, or high school students.

calendarFaqs.q: What days are students off at Pomona Unified in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: During the student school year, full days off include September 7 and 15; November 2, 11, and 23–27; December 21–January 1; January 18–19; February 8 and 15; and March 29–April 2. August 6, 7, 10, and 11 are staff dates before classes begin.

calendarFaqs.q: Is Pomona Unified closed for the full Thanksgiving week in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Pomona Unified lists schools not in session from November 23-25, 2026, followed by Thanksgiving holidays on November 26-27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families verify Pomona Unified calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use Pomona Unified's official School Year Calendars page and announcements from the assigned school for revisions, bell times, testing, athletics, graduation, and campus events.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official Pomona Unified 2026–27 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Pomona Unified calendar PDF linked in the downloads section. The separate ICS file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if the district changes its calendar.

Before the first student day, PUSD also lists professional development on Aug. 6, 7 and 10, followed by a teacher work day on Aug. 11. Shortened days are listed separately because students still attend school.

customSections.label: What Changed From 2025–26
customSections.content: The first day remains August 12, and the calendar still lists 180 student days. The last day is one calendar day earlier, while Winter Break and Spring Break each start and end one day earlier than in 2025–26.
